lines: Everything you've made is one keystroke away. Open the search drawer.
It slides in from the right with a live feed of your files — notes, canvases, notebooks, scripts.
Start typing and it filters across files, bookmarks, and the web at once.
One search, every workspace — no folders to dig through.

steps.checkpoint: a search drawer is open on the right showing a feed of file cards (markdown notes, a canvas, a notebook, a python script)
steps.label: capture the open drawer
